source_snapshot.procedure: 1 s press from Off powers on; observe 2 Hz then 0.5 Hz green states; 1 s press in OS graceful shutdown; 4 s hold forced off.
source_snapshot.criteria: Includes those behaviors but item 7 says an On node should remain On after one button press.
source_snapshot.bundle: Common; physical and destructive power case.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/HIGH; separates graceful and forced-off checkpoints and adds recovery.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Physical-only boundary accepted but source contradiction not resolved.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds LED evidence and force-off approval/recovery.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-02/05/06 require exact button/LED/power oracle; ED-04/07/08 require recovery; ED-11/12 prohibit retry; ED-36/38 reserve verdict.

original_test_intent: Verify physical power-button power-on, startup LED cadence, short-press OS behavior and long-press forced-off behavior across defined power states, with boot and recovery evidence.
original_method: Identify button/LED and initial state; timestamp a qualified operator's measured presses: short press from Off, startup 2 Hz and 0.5 Hz green phases, successful OS boot, short press in OS using the engineering-selected policy, then after a clean restart one separate approved >4 s force-off; collect OS/BMC/ACPI/SEL and video evidence and recover to the approved final state.
manual_activity: Qualified operator performs measured physical presses and observes LEDs; agent may collect OS/BMC state, logs and analyze video.
required_inputs: Exact short-press behavior when On and OS ACPI policy
2 Hz/0.5 Hz color, frequency/duty/tolerance and state-transition timing
Long-hold threshold, workload drain, recovery and final-state plan
safety_requirements: Run on dedicated quiesced node with console/power recovery
Measure press duration and test short/long actions separately
Authorize forced off only after workload/storage safeguards
Stop on wrong node, unexpected shutdown, stuck button, boot/log/storage fault; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Collect power/OS/BMC/ACPI/SEL state and timestamped evidence
Analyze supplied video for LED cadence and press timing
Do not press hardware, choose between contradictory short-press outcomes, force power without approval, retry or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve Criteria 6 versus 7 for On-state short press
Approve LED cadence/timing and power-state definitions
Approve long-hold/destructive safeguards, recovery and final state
Review evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No command replaces the physical button actuation and optical cadence, although software/BMC state is useful corroboration.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use timestamped video plus OS/BMC power-state and ACPI shutdown logs around separately staged physical actions.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: One-second and four-second actions, 2 Hz/0.5 Hz green phases, boot, graceful and forced-off coverage remain; contradictory short-press oracle is pending.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute each state/action as an isolated checkpoint with monotonic timing, physical video, digital state correlation and recovery between destructive phases.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact policy/tolerances, contradiction isolation, workload protection and final-state recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Combining the sequence can hide whether a short press invoked OS shutdown, was ignored, or the node was already transitioning.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS ACPI policy can change short-press behavior independently of hardware; force-off risks data loss and must not be used as a retry.

project_override_considerations: If Criteria 7 describes a multi-node chassis where only an Off target node changes, engineering must define node selection and preserve other nodes; do not apply that interpretation without approval.
expected_evidence: Measured press/video timeline and LED frequency/color
OS boot and graceful-shutdown ACPI/journal evidence

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure step 4 and Criteria 6 require a one-second press while On/in OS to shut down gracefully, but Criteria 7 says a node that is On should remain On after pressing the power button once. Both cannot be the acceptance result for the same state/action without a multi-node or policy distinction not present in the row.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Other checkpoints are clear and static review can finish; execution of the contradictory short-press checkpoint awaits engineering resolution.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2264 Wistron-HW-00370-V004: reconcile Procedure step 4/Criteria 6 (one-second press while On gracefully shuts down) with Criteria 7 (an On node remains On after one press), including any multi-node targeting or OS ACPI policy; approve button/LED mapping, 2 Hz and 0.5 Hz green timing tolerances and state boundaries, short/long press timing, dedicated-node workload/storage safeguards, >4-second force-off approval, recovery and final state.

review_improvement: Preserves every source checkpoint while exposing the mutually exclusive short-press expectations and isolating the destructive long-hold test.
independent_technical_reasoning: The physical button generates a platform/ACPI event whose short-press effect may depend on OS policy, while a long hold generally invokes hardware override. Those paths must be tested separately. The source simultaneously expects shutdown and no change for the same apparent On-state short press, so assigning a verdict would be fabricated unless node targeting or policy distinguishes them. LED cadence also requires optical timing, not merely power-state logs.
